QF.id: XXVA Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards_16

question.text: The ethical obligation of 'continuous learning' for research services personnel means:

answer.text: Attending one compliance training during the career and relying on that knowledge forever
Keeping up-to-date with regulatory changes, market developments, and evolving best practices through ongoing education and certification renewal
Learning only about the specific stocks covered by the entity
Delegating all learning to junior staff and relying on their summaries

explanation.text: The Logic: The SEBI Research Analyst framework requires associated persons to hold and maintain the relevant NISM certification, including obtaining fresh certification before expiry. In practice this functions as an ongoing learning obligation — personnel must keep up with regulatory changes, market developments, and evolving best practices through periodic re-certification and continued education. The Trap: Attending a single training and never refreshing is inadequate. Restricting learning to a narrow stock universe ignores the broader regulatory and market context, and personal learning obligations cannot be delegated to junior staff summaries. Note: The Series XV Research Analyst workbook pages reviewed support qualification and fresh NISM certification requirements before expiry/within three years, but do not explicitly describe the broader "continuous learning, ongoing education, best practices" obligation in those terms. The framing above reflects general regulatory practice rather than a workbook citation.
